name: anymem
description: Shared memory for AI coding agents, stored in your own Cloudflare account. Recall on every prompt, capture at the end of a session, one memory store across every machine.

url.title: Worker URL
url.description: Address of your anymem Worker. Leave empty and run the anymem skill's setup script to create one.

token.title: Access token
token.description: Bearer token for your anymem Worker. Stored in the secure credential store.
